name: Pakistan Driving License Signs Quiz
author: fazalniazi

sections.description:
Pakistan Driving License Signs Quiz helps visitors prepare for the Pakistan Driving License (E-Sign) Test directly on your WordPress website.

Features

  • 4 Quiz Categories: Car/Jeep, Motorcycle, LTV/HTV/PSV, and English Test
  • MCQ Format: Multiple choice questions matching the real E-Sign test format
  • Instant Feedback: Shows correct/wrong answers immediately after selection
  • Explanations: Detailed explanation for every question
  • Score & Result: Pass/Fail result with percentage score
  • Progress Bar: Visual progress indicator throughout the quiz
  • Randomized Questions: Questions and options are shuffled each time
  • Shortcode: Easy to embed on any page or post
  • Widget: Add the quiz to any sidebar or widget area
  • Fully Responsive: Works perfectly on mobile, tablet, and desktop
  • No registration required: Works for all visitors instantly

How to Use

Shortcode (Full Quiz with category selector):
[pakistan_driving_signs_quiz]

Shortcode (Specific category):
[pakistan_driving_signs_quiz category=”car”]
[pakistan_driving_signs_quiz category=”motorcycle”]
[pakistan_driving_signs_quiz category=”ltv”]
[pakistan_driving_signs_quiz category=”english”]

Shortcode (Custom settings):
[pakistan_driving_signs_quiz category=”car” questions=”10″ pass_mark=”60″ show_explanation=”yes”]

Shortcode Parameters

  • category — car | motorcycle | ltv | english (default: shows selector)
  • questions — Number of questions (default: 10)
  • pass_mark — Percentage required to pass (default: 60)
  • show_explanation — yes | no (default: yes)
  • title — Custom title text

Widget

Go to Appearance → Widgets and add the Pakistan Driving Signs Quiz widget to any sidebar.

Quiz Categories

  • Car / Jeep Test — Road signs, rules, and traffic regulations for car drivers
  • Motorcycle Test — Specific questions for motorcyclists including helmet rules
  • LTV / HTV / PSV Test — Questions for commercial and heavy vehicle drivers
  • Test in English — English terminology used on road signs
sections.installation:
1. Upload the pakistan-driving-signs-quiz folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Add the shortcode [pakistan_driving_signs_quiz] to any page or post
  4. Or use the Pakistan Driving Signs Quiz widget in your sidebar
sections.faq:
What categories does the quiz support?

Car/Jeep, Motorcycle, LTV/HTV/PSV, and English sign terminology — matching the real Pakistan E-Sign test format.

Can I use this on multiple pages?

Yes! You can add the shortcode [pakistan_driving_signs_quiz] to as many pages or posts as you like.

Can I change the number of questions?

Yes. Use [pakistan_driving_signs_quiz questions="5"] to set any number between 1 and 15.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes, the quiz is fully responsive and works on all screen sizes.
